::: proof

By @exr-mse-expand and @exr-bias-sq-plus-var,
$\mselr{\hparam}$ and $\sqf{\bias{\hparam}} + \var{\hparam}$
both equal $\E{\hparam^2} - 2\E{\hparam}\param + \param^2$,
so they are equal to each other.

:::

::: {#rem-mse-bias-variance-prediction}

#### The same split for predictions

@thm-mse-bias-variance concerns an estimator of a parameter.
For the squared error of a *prediction* of a new outcome,
the probability notes prove the same split with one more term,
the [irreducible error](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-irreducible-error)
from the noise in that outcome:
[expected squared prediction error](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#thm-prediction-error)
equals squared bias plus variance plus the noise variance.

:::
